visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a person's hands delicately picking up and moving several vibrant fabric pouches on a light-colored wooden desk surface. These pouches exhibit various colors including bright red, sunny yellow with floral patterns, and pale light blue. The lighting is bright and even, likely from a nearby window or lamp, creating soft shadows on the wood. (2) The focus shifts to a collection of DIY tools: a rectangular wooden frame with a textured cork interior, a pair of sharp metal scissors, and a retail package of clear double-sided adhesive tape. The person holds the tape package close to the lens to show its labels and features. In the background, a white lamp and a small plant are visible, providing a cozy indoor home setting. (3) Next, the person is seen carefully peeling off a clear protective film from the transparent cover of the wooden frame. Their fingers move with precision, and the light reflects off the smooth surface of the film as it is removed, revealing the clean glass or acrylic underneath. (4) During the layout phase, the person places the colorful fabric pouches inside the empty wooden frame. They experiment with different arrangements, moving a red pouch to the bottom left and a light blue one to the top center. The scene captures the spatial planning of the items against the neutral brown background of the cork. (5) The creator then uses the scissors to cut small, square segments of the clear double-sided tape. They apply these segments to the back of each pouch and firmly press the items onto the cork board. In the soft-focus background, a tablet computer is propped up, showing a scene from a movie or drama with characters visible on the screen. (6) A detailed close-up shot features a unique white fabric pouch shaped like a traditional clasp-purse with red embroidered characters on the front. The person’s hands demonstrate the functionality of the metal clasp by opening it wide to show the empty red-lined interior before snapping it shut and placing it in the frame. (7) To conclude, the person secures the clear cover back onto the wooden frame. They lift the completed DIY project to face the camera, showcasing the neatly aligned amulets through the glass. The final shot provides a clear view of the entire finished display, which includes several differently colored and sized pouches arranged in rows.
